extracted.intended_audience: registered patent practitioners (attorneys/agents) and respondents seeking reinstatement before the USPTO; Office of Enrollment and Discipline stakeholders
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts the conditions and procedural requirements imposed by the USPTO Office of Enrollment and Discipline for reinstatement of a suspended practitioner (here, John H. Faro). Focuses on payment, notice, authorization to practice, and timing for satisfying conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conditional grant of petition for reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: the Petition for Reinstatement is CONDITIONALLY GRANTED
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decision states the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined reinstatement is conditionally granted after review of the petition, affidavit, supplemental responses, and other record information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Written notification to Director that full payment submitted
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitioner notifying the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline, in writing, that full payment of the costs set forth in 37 CFR § 11.60(d)(2) for In re Faro, USPTO Proceeding No. D2015-27 has been submitted to the USPTO
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This written notice to the Director is an explicit condition precedent to reinstatement; it must indicate that the full payment has been submitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: USPTO's receipt of full payment of disciplinary costs
rubrics_metrics.description: USPTO’s receipt of Petitioner’s full payment of all costs set forth in 37 CFR § 11.60(d)(2) for In re Faro, USPTO Proceeding No. D2015-27
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement is conditioned on timely receipt by the USPTO of the full payment of costs specified by 37 C.F.R. § 11.60(d)(2) (i.e., the Director’s authority to condition reinstatement on payment of disciplinary proceeding costs).

rubrics_metrics.name: No authorization to practice until conditions satisfied
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitioner is not authorized to practice, and shall not practice, before the USPTO until the conditions set forth in Paragraphs 2. a. and 2. b., above, have been fulfilled
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even though the petition is conditionally granted, the practitioner remains prohibited from practicing before the USPTO until both the written notice and USPTO's receipt of full payment have occurred.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automatic rescission and revocation if conditions not met within 60 days of publication
rubrics_metrics.description: The conditional granting of the Petition for Reinstatement shall be automatically and immediately RESCINDED and REVOKED should the conditions ... not be fully satisfied within sixty (60) days of the publication of this DECISION ON PETITION FOR REINSTATEMENT in the Official Gazette.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is a firm 60-day compliance window measured from publication in the Official Gazette; failure to fully satisfy conditions in that timeframe causes automatic rescission/revocation without further discretionary action.
